tonight.headline: Wilson needs one more protocol step — and his cover is questionable too
body: Bad news first: Garrett Wilson practised fully Friday but is still in the concussion protocol — Glenn says he has 'one more step to go through before he's cleared' and is 'confident' he plays (newyorkjets.com 13 Nov 16:30). He is questionable, and so is his first cover, Denzel Boston (toe; back on the field Friday, NBC 13 Nov 18:24Z). Stefon Diggs scored 20.3 Thursday on your bench, which is now the bar for Wilson's slot. Good news: Tuten was limited Friday and Coen says he is 'good to go' (SI 13 Nov) — his Sunday check is gone.

Likely banked 27.7 Thursday; Nicky Jam have Daniels' 20.8. ESPN: 147.7 to 118.5, 66%. The lineup as set is the projection lineup — nothing to tap today. Kenneth Walker, their 26.2-point back, arrived Friday with a tight groin and missed practice; he is questionable (Reid via Yahoo 13 Nov 20:33Z). One check for you, Sunday 10:30 CDMX: Wilson.

case.label: Their side
case.body: Walker's groin broke Friday morning, after ESPN set his 26.2 — that number is not priced. Carnell Tate is OUT and still in their WR slot (0.0); A.J. Brown and Jalen Coker sit on their bench to replace him.

case.label: Your check
case.body: If Wilson is inactive at 10:30: Boston if Boston is active, otherwise DK Metcalf, who kicks off at 19:20 and is still movable after the noon games lock.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Wilson not cleared on Saturday — the Jets would rule him out and the check becomes a Saturday swap. Walker active and healthy — then the 66% is ESPN's honest number.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · check Sun 15 Nov 10:30 CDMX
doFirst.title: If Wilson is inactive, start Boston — or Metcalf
doFirst.subtitle: Wilson starts. This is the plan if the protocol's last step fails.

case.label: The check
case.body: Wilson was full Friday; Glenn: 'one more step to go through before he's cleared' (newyorkjets.com 13 Nov 16:30). Concussion clearance needs an independent neurologist, so the answer can come Saturday or not until inactives.

case.label: The cover
case.body: Boston (12.8, toe) missed Wednesday and Thursday and returned Friday — 'the optimistic side of questionable', Monken 'trending in the right direction' (NBC 13 Nov 18:24Z). If he is also inactive, Metcalf (10.6) plays Sunday night at Cincinnati and can still be moved in after noon.

case.label: Who is throwing
case.body: Boston: Deshaun Watson, the Browns' starter again (Athlon 13 Nov). Metcalf: Aaron Rodgers, off the report.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Wilson is inactive and the cover scores under Diggs' 20.3 — the Tuesday swap then closes WRONG on its outcome, whatever this card does. The card itself is wrong only if Metcalf outscores Boston after Boston was chosen.

whatWentWrong.title: Diggs scored 20.3 on the bench
whatWentWrong.lead: The Tuesday swap put Wilson in on a 2.0 projection edge. Diggs then drew 10 targets and scored the winner.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Wilson 12.8 against Diggs 10.8 on Tuesday — exactly 2.0, labelled PROJECTION. Diggs: 10 targets, 6 catches, 20.3 (archive), the late touchdown in a 24-21 win (VAVEL 12 Nov).

case.label: Why it was still the call
case.body: Diggs played Thursday, so the slot had to be set before Wilson's status was known. The projection lineup is the policy; the backtest found nothing that beats it.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Wilson (or his cover) scores 20.3 or more — then the swap closes RIGHT. Below it, WRONG on the outcome. Either way it is one decision, not a pattern.
